name: Spicy Shrimp Curry with Tomatoes, Spinach & Cilantro over Rice

ingredients.name: raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add broth and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups basmati rice
24 fl oz (3 cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
9 tomatoes
3 (1 inch) pieces ginger root
1 ½ limes
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ (5 oz) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: If using frozen shrimp, place them in a colander and run under cold water to thaw them slightly and remove any ice crystals. (If using fresh shrimp, skip this step.) Place the shrimp on a clean towel or paper towels and pat dry.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 ¼ lb raw peeled shrimp, fresh or frozen

instructions.primary_message: Small dice tomatoes; place in a medium bowl and set aside.
Peel and mince ginger and garlic; place in a small bowl and set aside.
Peel, halve, and small dice onions.
Preheat a large pot over medium heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add ginger, garlic, sugar, and spices to the pot with the onion. Continue to cook, stirring constantly, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp curry powder
1 tbsp chili powder
1 tbsp coriander, ground
1 tbsp cumin, ground
2 tsp salt
1 ½ tsp black pepper
1 ½ tsp turmeric, ground

instructions.primary_message: Add tomatoes, coconut milk, and broth to the pot; stir to combine the curry and bring to a boil over medium-high heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until slightly thickened, about 10 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (13.5 fl oz) cans coconut milk
12 fl oz (1 ½ cups) chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: While the curry cooks, cut limes into wedges and set aside for serving.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves.

Once the curry has thickened, add shrimp and half of the cilantro (reserving the rest for garnish) to the pot; stir to combine. Return to a simmer and cook, stirring occasionally, until the shrimp are cooked through, 3-4 minutes.
Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful; stir to combine.
Divide rice and shrimp curry between bowls; sprinkle with reserved cilantro and serve with lime wedges. Enjoy!
